blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The Check age rules before choosing a business idea.

rows: Contracts

Under Indian contract law, an agreement made by a minor (under 18) is treated as void, not just risky. The Privy Council decided this in Mohori Bibee v Dharmodas Ghose (1903), and later court summaries say the Supreme Court repeated it in 2014.

Before 18, let a parent or guardian be the person who signs with a customer, or keep jobs small, paid on delivery and in writing by message. Ask a lawyer or a chartered accountant (CA) for anything big.
Bank account

An RBI circular reported in April 2025 lets a minor aged 10 or more run a savings account on their own, within the amount and terms each bank sets. Younger minors use a guardian. Overdrafts are not allowed.
Ask your bank what it allows. Keep business money in a separate account from pocket money, even if it is a guardian account.
Tax on a minor's income

A minor's income is normally added to the income of the parent who earns more. Income from the child's own skill, talent or manual work is excluded, but returns from investing that money are added. The rule is section 64(1A) of the old Act and moves to section 99(1A) under the Income-tax Act, 2025, which applies from 1 April 2026.
Tell your parents about your earnings. Ask a CA how to file. Do not hide income to keep things simple.
GST

Secondary explainers give GST registration limits for service providers of Rs 20 lakh a year (Rs 10 lakh in special category states). E-commerce operators and some other cases need registration whatever the turnover, and platforms differ on what they accept.

A small service business is far below the limit. If you sell goods through Amazon, Meesho or a similar platform, read the platform's current seller page and check gst.gov.in first. Udyam registration for small businesses is free and optional, but it needs an adult's Aadhaar, so ask a CA before you try it.
Selling food

FSSAI's order of 13 March 2026 sets FSSAI registration for food businesses with turnover up to Rs 1.5 crore, from 1 April 2026. Registration and licences are now valid without a fixed end date, subject to inspections.
If you bake or cook to sell, register first on FSSAI's online portal, FoSCoS. An adult in the family may need to be the registered operator.
YouTube and ads

YouTube lets a creator earn from ads if they are 18 or have a legal guardian over 18 who handles the AdSense payments. Memberships and Super Chat need the creator to be 18. AdSense itself accepts only applicants aged 18 or more, and a parent can apply with their own account.
Start the channel for practice and proof. Let a parent set up the payment side later.

Shop owners, tuition teachers, salons, cafes and small event groups near you.

Scalable
Shops and home businesses that sell but post rarely: boutiques, bakers, tutors, gyms, clinics.
Simple web pages and Google Business profiles for local shops
Scalable
Local businesses with no web page, no map listing, or wrong phone numbers online.
Tutoring and small doubt-clearing groups
Scalable with a business layer
Parents of school students, and college juniors who want help with one subject or exam.
Study notes, templates and planners you make yourself
Scalable with a business layer
Students in lower classes or juniors in your college who want clean notes, resume templates, or exam planners.
Short-video editing for creators, coaching classes and shops
Your phone or laptop and a free or low-cost editor you already have. List any app or storage you must pay for, then price each clip above that cost plus your time.
Posters, menus and logos for local shops
A free design tool and a phone. Count printing and travel as your only real costs, and ask the customer to pay for printing.
Social media and a WhatsApp catalogue for local shops
Your phone and time. The shop pays for any ads. Write down every rupee they spend so the numbers are honest.
Simple web pages and Google Business profiles for local shops
Free page builders exist. Check the domain and hosting price on the provider's own page, and have the shop own the account.
Tutoring and small doubt-clearing groups
Almost nothing for home or online teaching. Add any tool you must buy, such as a paid video app or a printed set of notes.
Study notes, templates and planners you make yourself
Your time and a free design tool. Check the fees of the payment or store tool you pick before you price.
Like, rate or subscribe tasks that pay small amounts first

India's cybercrime centre (I4C) found over 100 websites running task frauds in 2023. The government blocked them. The pattern is small early payouts, then a demand to deposit more to unlock bigger earnings, and then the money is frozen.
Never pay to work. Report on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
A course fee to learn dropshipping, Amazon selling or a franchise

In the United States the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) sued a dropshipping course seller in 2024 for promising high monthly earnings. We found no Indian regulator advisory on these courses. Customers on review sites report refund problems. Course sellers often show student revenue and hide costs.
Learn the same basics free first. If you still pay, get the refund rule in writing and use a payment method that allows refunds.
Earn by bringing in more members
India's Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules 2021 prohibit pyramid and money circulation schemes. A real direct-selling firm earns from product sales, not from the joining fees of new members.
Walk away from any plan where your main income is recruiting.
Fake franchise offers and 'be your own boss' fees
A real franchise explains its costs, contract and support in writing. A scammer pushes you to pay a deposit this week.
Talk to two existing franchise owners, not the ones the seller names. Show everything to a parent before you pay.
Someone asks for your OTP, PIN or bank login
No honest customer or employer needs them.
Stop the chat. Block. Tell a parent.
